title: CGX Build Helper / DIY-to-Government Interface

surfaces.mode: guided build + simple language + mandatory safety/skill/tool checks
process capability, QA, traceability, integration and production scheduling
requirements, compliance, public-benefit, procurement evidence and lifecycle
experimental design, uncertainty, falsifiers, datasets and publication-ready provenance
local-material assessment, ecological gates, volunteer-safe tasks and public education
resource inventory, seed dependence, repair/reproduction and latency-tolerant procedures

interaction_flow: identify local horizon and available printer/tools/materials
select catalogue item or decompose novel function into primitives
show evidence/readiness and seed dependencies before build
choose objectives: low-cost / local-only / eco-first / lightweight / repairable / precision / throughput
emit build packet + DIY assembly packet + test packet
compile machine-executable job only after gates pass
inspect and compare expected vs measured
write snapshot/DBR receipt and update node capability if independently justified
AI_boundary: helper may plan, explain, compare and compile
hazardous/high-energy/high-pressure/reactive chemistry routes require qualified module and appropriate competent review
unknown/unsupported material substitutions are surfaced as experiments, not silently accepted

portfolio_delivery_model.status: candidate organizational pattern, not incorporated governance
portfolio_delivery_model.pattern: small accountable professional core + paid/benefit-bearing contributors and volunteers for bounded safe work + research/education/community partners
portfolio_delivery_model.rule: legal, employment, insurance, volunteer, IP, export-control and public-safety requirements remain jurisdiction-specific
